items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: so this night he called me and he asked me was I busy and I said no man, so I got together with him and his singer, see, Charlie Purcell and we went down to 666 Fifth Avenue and there was about six people, three couples and we entertained, played soft music and singing

ctx.x: He was a club date man.
Yeah, and he said, 'Can you work tonight?' and I said 'Yep' and he said, 'Come up here and I'll brief you on some of the music.' Charlie Purcell was the singer. So --
